subject: german
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in German on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (German↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: What does 'die Unterkunft' mean?
questions.explain: 'Die Unterkunft' means 'accommodation'. 'Food' is 'das Essen'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I would like to book a double room'?
questions.explain: 'Buchen' = 'to book' and 'ein Doppelzimmer' = 'a double room'; 'Einzelzimmer' (single) and 'absagen' (cancel) are distractors.

questions.q: What does 'die Koffer packen' mean?
questions.explain: 'Packen' = 'to pack' and 'die Koffer' = 'the suitcases', so this means 'to pack the suitcases'.

questions.q: What does 'Der Zug hat Verspätung' mean?
questions.explain: 'Verspätung haben' means 'to be delayed/late', so 'Der Zug hat Verspätung' = 'The train is delayed'.

questions.q: What does 'herunterladen' mean?
questions.explain: 'Herunterladen' means 'to download' (literally 'to load down'). 'Hochladen' is 'to upload'.

questions.q: What does 'der Computer' need to read its files — 'das Passwort'?
questions.explain: 'Das Passwort' means 'the password'.

questions.q: What does 'der Bildschirm' mean?
questions.explain: 'Der Bildschirm' means 'the screen'. ('Der Schirm' alone can mean umbrella — a near-miss.)

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I spend too much time online'?
options: Ich verbringe zu viel Zeit online
Ich verbringe zu viel Geld online
questions.explain: 'Zeit verbringen' = 'to spend time' and 'zu viel' = 'too much', so this means 'I spend too much time online'.

questions.q: What does 'die Umwelt' mean?
questions.explain: 'Die Umwelt' means 'the environment' (nature/planet), as in 'die Umwelt schützen' = 'to protect the environment'.

questions.q: What does 'die Klimaerwärmung' mean?
questions.explain: 'Die Klimaerwärmung' (also 'die globale Erwärmung') means 'global warming'.

questions.q: What does 'Ich wohne am Stadtrand' mean?
options: I live on the outskirts of town
I live in the city centre
questions.explain: 'Der Stadtrand' means 'the edge/outskirts of the town', so 'Ich wohne am Stadtrand' = 'I live on the outskirts'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'There is a lot of pollution'?
questions.explain: 'Es gibt viel' = 'there is a lot of' and 'Umweltverschmutzung' = 'pollution', so this is correct.

questions.q: What does 'öffentliche Verkehrsmittel' mean?
questions.explain: 'Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel' means 'public transport'. A traffic jam is 'der Stau'.

questions.q: What does 'Wir sollten mehr recyceln' mean?
questions.explain: 'Wir sollten' is the conditional of 'sollen' = 'we should'; 'mehr' = 'more'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Next year I will travel to Austria' (future)?
options: Nächstes Jahr werde ich nach Österreich reisen
Letztes Jahr bin ich nach Österreich gereist
questions.explain: 'Werde... reisen' is the future tense 'will travel'; with 'nächstes Jahr' (next year) the future is correct.

questions.q: What does 'Man muss die Umwelt schützen' mean?
options: We want to protect the environment
questions.explain: 'Man muss' + infinitive means 'one/we must', so this is 'We must protect the environment'.

questions.q: What does 'im Ausland' mean?
questions.explain: 'Im Ausland' means 'abroad'. 'Das Ausland' = foreign countries; 'das Inland' = home country.

questions.q: What does 'die Werbung' mean?
questions.explain: 'Die Werbung' means 'advertising/adverts'.

questions.q: What does 'der Müll' mean?
questions.explain: 'Der Müll' means 'rubbish/waste'. 'Müll trennen' = 'to separate the rubbish (for recycling)'.

questions.q: What does 'Zurzeit wohne ich in der Stadt' mean?
options: At the moment I live in the city
I used to live in the city
I will live in the city
I rarely live in the city
questions.explain: 'Zurzeit' means 'at the moment / currently', so this is 'At the moment I live in the city'.
